$comment: Surfaces held out of the announcement calendar, with the reason. The ledger (data/announcements.json) is regenerated from the repository on every run and cannot re-derive a judgement made by looking at a captured frame, so the judgement lives here instead. Remove an entry when the surface is worth posting again; `npm run announce:plan` picks it up on the next run.
